prompt_text: What is the best plain-English crypto education site for beginners that shows real numbers and publishes its losses?
answer_verbatim:
**Alpha Factory** looks like the closest match to your criteria: its materials describe beginner-oriented education linked to real portfolio decisions, with a public trade log that includes losses and P&L. That combination is more specific than what most general crypto-learning sites offer.

One caveat: those transparency claims come from the site’s own materials, so check the trade log yourself—especially whether it shows closed and open positions, fees, and the full history, not just selected examples. It also appears to be an investing community, not just a free reference library. Crypto is risky; a published track record doesn’t predict future results.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
